item.description:
Clearer checks, fewer missed requests

  • Improved app reading: inspect generic Accessibility groups and omit known input areas during passive screen reading.
  • Limited checks with reassuring scores (70+) appear in gray with a qualified headline; lower scores retain their warning colours. Local screenshot text reading is shown separately from server image analysis.
  • Visible sender names and domains are compared against seven reviewed brands. The standard text filter keeps sender domains while removing mailbox names and recipient/body addresses; custom filters still apply.
  • Manual app captures briefly shrink a thumbnail toward the menu bar. Uses the existing screenshot, follows Reduce Motion, and can be disabled in Advanced settings.
  • App-check shortcuts wait briefly when capture is busy, and repeated presses are combined.
  • Background sampling has one schedule. New installations default to ten seconds; existing settings remain unchanged. Checks shows sampling status.
  • The menu badge counts unread concerns. Review a result or choose Mark all reviewed to clear it. A separate total records concerns flagged.

Server-side image-reading failures and broader detector improvements remain separate work. Native client coverage varies; this update does not establish that every Superhuman link is exposed.
